capabilities: Upload pasted, dropped, or existing vault attachments to S3-compatible storage
Rewrite note links to point at storage objects, with content-hash deduplication
Keep, trim, and back-fill local copies so attachments render offline and on new devices
Manage all attachments in one dialog with counted filters and batch actions
Clean up unreferenced cloud objects and local files after confirmation
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. The README warns that Android device regression testing stopped at version 1.1.2, that cloud deletions cannot be undone, and that command IDs changed in recent versions so hotkeys need rebinding.
motivation: The README states: "Upload-only plugins break offline; localize-only plugins need one online pass first. This one does both."
problem: Upload-only attachment plugins break offline rendering and localize-only plugins grow the vault and need an online pass first; Obsidian has no built-in way to keep attachments in your own cloud storage while staying offline-capable.

relations.evidence: it goes to your S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, MinIO, Backblaze B2, self-hosted)
relations.plugin: Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3 / MinIO / Backblaze B2

requires.name: An S3-compatible bucket you control (Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, MinIO, Backblaze B2, or self-hosted)
S3 access key ID and secret access key with ListBucket permission

summary: Attachment cache that uploads vault attachments to your own S3-compatible storage, rewrites links, and keeps local copies so files still render offline.
